name: OmaGAWD
author: David
description: Winamp soul. Omarchy fit. Badass llama dance moves. Stream Jellyfin, play local music, or tune into Cliamp radio in a compact player that follows your theme, with a real frequency spectrum, keyboard control, and remembered playlists. Tab and arrows browse; Return plays; Alt+Return adds without skipping a beat. The player llama switches between running man and side shuffle while your music plays.

barWidget.description: Llama button for Jellyfin, local music and live radio
